# ST Tracker - Gujarat ST (GSRTC) Live Bus Tracker
> ST Tracker (https://gsrtc.shivrajsinh.in & https://tracker.shivrajsinh.in) is a free, web-based real-time GPS tracking and timetable utility for Gujarat ST (GSRTC) buses and commuters.

## Overview
- **Primary Website / Landing**: https://gsrtc.shivrajsinh.in/
- **Live Web App (PWA)**: https://tracker.shivrajsinh.in/
- **Developer**: Shivrajsinh Zala (https://shivrajsinh.in)
- **Coverage**: Covers all 8,554+ Gujarat ST buses and 19,026+ bus stops across Gujarat, India.
- **Languages**: English and Gujarati (ગુજરાતી).
- **Cost**: 100% Free, no sign-up or app installation required. Works in any browser (Chrome, Safari, Firefox).

## Key Features & Capabilities
1. **Live GPS Bus Tracking by Number Plate**: Enter any Gujarat ST bus plate (e.g. `GJ-18-ZT-1028`, `GJ-18-ZT-2586`) to view its exact live location on an interactive map, current speed (km/h), next stop ETA, and a direct "Open in Google Maps" link.
2. **Online Booking / PNR Lookup**: Track buses reserved online via GSRTC, redBus, or AbhiBus by entering the ticket PNR number.
3. **Full Timetable & Departure Countdown**: Search scheduled and running buses between any two stations with live delay alerts (`🟢 On Time`, `🟡 Late`).
4. **Nearby Bus Stands Radar**: Uses geolocation to identify the nearest ST bus depots and stops with precise distances.
5. **Crowd & Occupancy Reports**: Community-driven crowd indicators showing free seats, standing room, or cancellations.
6. **Arrival Notifications**: Set automatic arrival alerts to get notified before a bus reaches your chosen stop.

## Core Route Guides & Corridors
- [Ahmedabad to Vadodara ST Bus](https://gsrtc.shivrajsinh.in/ahmedabad-vadodara-bus.html): Live timetables and express departures.
- [Ahmedabad to Rajkot ST Bus](https://gsrtc.shivrajsinh.in/ahmedabad-rajkot-bus.html): Express and Gurjarnagri tracking.
- [Vadodara to Surat ST Bus](https://gsrtc.shivrajsinh.in/vadodara-surat-bus.html): South Gujarat intercity schedule.
- [Rajkot to Morbi ST Bus](https://gsrtc.shivrajsinh.in/rajkot-morbi-bus.html): Real-time commuter schedule.
- [Ahmedabad to Surat ST Bus](https://gsrtc.shivrajsinh.in/ahmedabad-surat-bus.html): AC Sleeper and Express tracking.
- [Ahmedabad to Gandhinagar ST Bus](https://gsrtc.shivrajsinh.in/ahmedabad-gandhinagar-bus.html): Twin-city shuttle schedule.
- [Ahmedabad to Somnath ST Bus](https://gsrtc.shivrajsinh.in/ahmedabad-somnath-bus.html): Saurashtra pilgrim route tracker.
- [Ahmedabad to Dwarka ST Bus](https://gsrtc.shivrajsinh.in/ahmedabad-dwarka-bus.html): Overnight AC & Sleeper timetable.

- [GSRTC Bus Number Plate Format](https://gsrtc.shivrajsinh.in/gsrtc-bus-number-plate-format.html): Decodes RTO codes and numbering schemes.
- [GSRTC Bus Stand Helplines](https://gsrtc.shivrajsinh.in/gsrtc-bus-stand-helpline-numbers.html): Directory of official control room numbers.
- [GSRTC Tracking by PNR](https://gsrtc.shivrajsinh.in/gsrtc-online-booking-pnr-tracking.html): Guide to tracking booked tickets.
- [GSRTC Timetable Guide](https://gsrtc.shivrajsinh.in/gsrtc-bus-timetable.html): How to search across 19,000+ Gujarat stations.
